answers.core: This would be a simple change to the WorldEnvironment node that would help a lot of games generate more pleasing fog effects. Seems like it would benefit a lot of people and not a ton of effort to maintain.
answers.workaround:
Should be able to be accomplished manually with screen reading shaders, at least to some extent.

https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/shaders/screen-reading_shaders.html

title: Add ability to configure the fog falloff as a gradient instead of a flat color
